The fraction to sell at this p is in decision_grid. From p >= 0.2 sell up to the limit.

sell_to_cap.text: At p={p}, the expected loss of staying exceeds the marginal exit cost up to the 45.00% capacity limit (cost 0.491% of value sold, x9.52 per unit of equity); the remaining 55.00% stays exposed to underlying / issuer risk. If the oracle falls, the unsold part is liquidated (shock 99.87% is above the 2.19% threshold).
